literal: according to · time · devise · what is suitable

meaning.en: To adopt measures suited to the time and circumstances.
meaning.zh: 根据不同时期的情况，采取适当的措施。

examples.zh: 政策要因时制宜，不能一成不变。
examples.en: Policy must adapt to the times and cannot stay fixed.

examples.zh: 防疫措施需要因时制宜地调整。
examples.en: Epidemic measures must be adjusted as the situation changes.

usage.en: Often paired with 因地制宜.

meaning.en: To keep one's promises.
meaning.zh: 说话算数，讲信用。

examples.zh: 他言而有信，答应的事一定做到。
examples.en: He is true to his word and always does what he promised.

examples.zh: 做生意要言而有信。
examples.en: In business you must keep your promises.

story.en: Zixia in the Analects: 'In dealing with friends, his words are trustworthy' (与朋友交，言而有信).

meaning.en: Not much, but better than having nothing at all.
meaning.zh: 虽然不太好，但比没有强一点。

examples.zh: 这点补助虽少，也聊胜于无。
examples.en: The subsidy is small, but better than nothing.

examples.zh: 他的安慰聊胜于无。
examples.en: His comfort was better than nothing.

meaning.en: Sharp-minded and competent.
meaning.zh: 聪明机灵，有办事能力。

examples.zh: 这位女经理精明能干。
examples.en: The manager is sharp and capable.

examples.zh: 他是个精明能干的生意人。
examples.en: He is a shrewd and capable businessman.

natural: turn right and wrong upside down

meaning.en: To deliberately twist right and wrong.
meaning.zh: 故意把对的说成错的，错的说成对的。

examples.zh: 他当众颠倒是非，污蔑同事。
examples.en: He twisted the facts in public to slander his colleague.

examples.zh: 不要听信颠倒是非的谣言。
examples.en: Don't believe rumours that distort right and wrong.

usage.en: Predicate; disapproving. Stronger than 混淆是非 in suggesting intent.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，含贬义，比“混淆是非”更强调故意。

meaning.en: A new cycle begins; the start of a new year.
meaning.zh: 旧的一年结束，新的一年开始。

examples.zh: 一元复始，万象更新，祝大家新年快乐。
examples.en: A new year begins and all things are renewed; happy New Year, everyone.

examples.zh: 一元复始，我们又踏上新的征程。
examples.en: As the year begins anew, we set out on a new journey.

meaning.en: Many people complain and grumble.
meaning.zh: 很多人七嘴八舌地抱怨、不满。

examples.zh: 员工对新制度啧有烦言。
examples.en: Staff are grumbling loudly about the new system.

examples.zh: 此事让邻居们啧有烦言。
examples.en: This has left the neighbours full of complaints.

story.en: Zuo Commentary: 'The various states have complaints' (啧有烦言), spoken as people clicked their tongues in discontent.
story.zh: 《左传》：“会同难，啧有烦言，莫之治也。”

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“对…啧有烦言”。

meaning.en: To burst out laughing involuntarily.
meaning.zh: 不由自主地笑出声来。

examples.zh: 听了他的解释，我不禁哑然失笑。
examples.en: Hearing his explanation, I couldn't help laughing.

examples.zh: 看到孩子的怪模样，她哑然失笑。
examples.en: Seeing the child's funny look, she burst out laughing.

meaning.en: The four cardinal virtues of traditional morality.
meaning.zh: 传统道德的四个基本准则：礼节、道义、廉洁、知耻。

equivalents: a sense of propriety and shame

examples.zh: 不讲礼义廉耻的人，难以立足于社会。
examples.en: Someone with no sense of propriety and shame can hardly hold a place in society.

examples.zh: 传统教育强调礼义廉耻。
examples.en: Traditional education stresses propriety, righteousness, integrity and shame.

story.en: Guanzi: 'Propriety, righteousness, integrity and a sense of shame are the four cords of the state' (礼义廉耻，国之四维).
story.zh: 《管子》：“礼义廉耻，国之四维；四维不张，国乃灭亡。”

date.zh: 战国至西汉 · 前4—前1世纪
date.en: Warring States to Western Han, 4th–1st c. BC

meaning.en: Boundless and unfocused; going on without limit.
meaning.zh: 没有边界，形容说话、想象等没有中心或限度。

examples.zh: 他们漫无边际地聊了一晚上。
examples.en: They chatted aimlessly all night.

examples.zh: 会议讨论漫无边际，毫无结果。
examples.en: The discussion rambled on and came to nothing.

meaning.en: Men and women should observe proper distinctions.
meaning.zh: 男女之间在礼节、行为等方面应有区别。

examples.zh: 古人讲究男女有别。
examples.en: The ancients stressed the proper distinction between men and women.

examples.zh: 宿舍管理规定男女有别，不得串门。
examples.en: Dormitory rules separate men and women; no visiting each other's rooms.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，传统礼教用语。

meaning.en: To profit from other people's quarrel without lifting a finger.
meaning.zh: 利用别人的矛盾，自己从中得到好处。

examples.zh: 两家争执不下，让第三方坐收渔利。
examples.en: The two sides wrangled and a third party picked up the profit.

examples.zh: 我们不能让对手坐收渔利。
examples.en: We can't let our rival reap the benefit.

usage.en: Predicate; from the 鹬蚌相争 story.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，出自“鹬蚌相争”的故事。

meaning.en: So grateful as to shed tears.
meaning.zh: 感激得流下眼泪。

examples.zh: 老人对救命恩人感激涕零。
examples.en: The old man was moved to tears by gratitude to his saviour.

examples.zh: 收到捐款，灾民感激涕零。
examples.en: On receiving the donations, the disaster victims wept with gratitude.

meaning.en: Still having a childlike heart despite age.
meaning.zh: 成年后仍保持孩子般的纯真。

examples.zh: 爷爷年过七十，依然童心未泯。
examples.en: Grandpa is over seventy yet still young at heart.

examples.zh: 这位画家童心未泯，作品充满趣味。
examples.en: The painter has kept a childlike heart and his works are full of fun.

literal: feel · kindness · bear on head · virtue

meaning.en: To be deeply grateful for kindness received.
meaning.zh: 感激别人给予的恩惠，表示谢意。

examples.zh: 他对资助他读书的人感恩戴德。
examples.en: He is deeply grateful to those who funded his schooling.

examples.zh: 别指望他会感恩戴德。
examples.en: Don't expect him to be grateful.

meaning.en: To be so carried away by success or emotion that one loses judgement.
meaning.zh: 因胜利或激动而失去理智，不清醒。

examples.zh: 别让一时的成功冲昏头脑。
examples.en: Don't let a moment's success go to your head.

examples.zh: 他被胜利冲昏头脑，忘了防守。
examples.en: Carried away by victory, he forgot to defend.

usage.en: Usually 被…冲昏头脑 or 冲昏了头脑.

meaning.en: Hard to pin down or predict.
meaning.zh: 难以确定，不能预料。

examples.zh: 他的态度捉摸不定。
examples.en: His attitude is hard to pin down.

examples.zh: 春天的天气捉摸不定。
examples.en: Spring weather is unpredictable.

meaning.en: To look as far as the eye can see.
meaning.zh: 用尽目力向远处看。

equivalents: look as far as the eye can see

examples.zh: 登上山顶，极目远眺，景色壮美。
examples.en: From the summit you gaze into the distance at a magnificent view.

examples.zh: 他站在海边，极目远眺。
examples.en: He stood by the sea looking out to the horizon.

meaning.en: So profound or mysterious that it can't be fathomed.
meaning.zh: 深奥或神秘得无法揣测。

examples.zh: 他总是一副高深莫测的样子。
examples.en: He always puts on an enigmatic air.

examples.zh: 这门理论让人觉得高深莫测。
examples.en: This theory seems unfathomable.

meaning.en: Bashful and affected; hesitant instead of straightforward.
meaning.zh: 形容举止不自然、不大方，不爽快。

examples.zh: 想去就去，别扭扭捏捏的。
examples.en: If you want to go, go; don't be coy about it.

examples.zh: 她扭扭捏捏地接过了红包。
examples.en: She took the red envelope bashfully.

meaning.en: To be greedy and lose one's scruples at the sight of money.
meaning.zh: 一见到钱就眼睛发亮，形容贪财。

examples.zh: 他见钱眼开，什么事都肯干。
examples.en: He is greedy for money and will do anything.

examples.zh: 别信那个见钱眼开的中介。
examples.en: Don't trust that money-grubbing agent.

meaning.en: To use both hands in turn, or to do several things at once.
meaning.zh: 两手轮流或同时做事，也比喻同时做几件事。

equivalents: work on two fronts at once

examples.zh: 他左右开弓，连扇了两个耳光。
examples.en: He swung with both hands, slapping twice.

examples.zh: 两条线路左右开弓，同时推进。
examples.en: The two lines were pushed forward on both fronts at once.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，可指动作，也可比喻。
